column5: BEST-VERIFIED SECTION IN THE CASINO: 6 of 9 frames verified `match` against measured DOM, not by eye - board 9163-4529 (tile 103.047 vs Figma 103.0408, gap 11.437 vs 11.449, radius 5.152 and border 3.4347 exact, ring colours #FF574A bomb / #17F9B4 gem on a constant #001615 tile, the frame's 150%/135.48% BOMB_CROP rather than a plain cover, committed gem.png/bomb.png and one extracted tile-bolt.svg), mobile board 9163-6955 holding the identical 0.1111 gap/tile ratio, bet panel Advanced-off 9163-7155 (every label verbatim, Mines: is the frame's combobox and the DOM reports no input[type=range], CTA 324x52 #56C7F3 radius 16), Advanced-Auto 9163-7972 (all six advanced labels), and both mobile panel states 9163-8481 / 9163-8621 including the frame's CTA-above-toggle inversion. The 4 page frames stay `partial` for reasons already on record: 9003-110110 tablet A is the REJECTED rival of B (A's 708-wide letterbox board with Manual/Auto above the CTA contradicts both B and mobile, so only B's shape was built) and 9163-5572's own info-block title and card art read 'Dice' - designer leftovers deliberately not reproduced, along with its clipped Dice trio below the frame bottom. ★ 2026-08-05 - BOTH previously-recorded wrong controls are now CLEARED, and the Potential Profit number was wrong TWICE for two different reasons. (1a) EDGE, fixed earlier (2cc8e0e): MinesGame.tsx floored at *98 (2%) against the rail's MINES_EDGE_BPS=9500 (_shared/mines.ts:126), quoting 1.46x where 1.4188x settles. (1b) ROUNDING, fixed now: the corrected client still floored to TWO DECIMALS (`Math.floor(mult * 95) / 100`) while the rail floors to ONE BPS (_shared/mines.ts:279-281, exact BigInt `Number(num / den)`), so 3 mines / 3 reveals printed 1.41x against a settled 1.4188x - low, never high, so no player was shortchanged, but still a number the rail contradicts. MinesGame.tsx:144-148 and MinefieldPro.tsx:120-121 now both delegate to a new pure module minesOdds.ts, a port of the rail's BigInt ladder rather than a second derivation of it, and minesOdds.test.ts pins it to bps values LIFTED FROM PRODUCTION points_game_rounds rows (10795 at 3 mines/1 reveal, 12337 at 3/2, 14188 at 3/3, 19166 at 3/5, 11875 at 5/1, 15000 at 5/2, 980448 at 6/12 where a 1000-point stake paid 98044) plus a source-text guard on MINES_EDGE_BPS / MINES_TILES in the edge function - an oracle the client cannot satisfy by agreeing with itself. The same pass floored the PAYOUT surfaces the integer POINTS rail floors: potentialProfit and the `Cash Out N` CTA both route through minesPayout(), because fmtAmount rounds POINTS half-up and a raw 10.795 printed 'Cash Out 11' against a settlement of 10. (2) GRID SIZE is honest rather than wired, and that is deliberate: the rail genuinely cannot take it. _shared/mines.ts hardcodes MINES_TILES=25 into the Pascal table, the Fisher-Yates board, the tile-range validation and the ladder; points-game mines_start (index.ts:3840-3860) accepts betAmount/mineCount/clientSeed and NO gridSize; pointsGameService.startPointsMines has no such parameter and gameSettlementService.ts:1624-1631 drops the field. minesTheme.LIVE_RAIL_GRID_SIZES=[25] now gates the control - all four design segments still render, 36/49/Custom are DISABLED with the reason on the control, and the pre-bet quote can no longer price a 64-tile ladder the server settles as 25. Widening it is an engine change plus an edge-function deploy, not a UI change; widen LIVE_RAIL_GRID_SIZES the day the engine takes a board size. ★ 2026-08-05 - THE GRID GATE IS NOW VERIFIED IN A BROWSER, AND THE SECOND SELECTOR IS CLOSED TOO. /play/mines loaded and the four segments read from the live DOM: 25 enabled, 36 and 49 disabled carrying the title "36-tile boards are not supported by the settlement engine yet", Custom disabled with "No custom board sizes are available". So the honest-control claim above is confirmed by measurement, not by reading the source. ★ CORRECTION to the line this replaces: MinefieldPro.tsx was described as "no longer mounted anywhere", and its own file header said the same. That is not accurate - Play.tsx:1291 still renders `case "mines": return <MinefieldPro isOpen onClose={...} />` in the dialog switch. The branch is not REACHED by a tile click, because ROUTED_GAME_PATHS maps mines to /play/mines first, but it is live code in the tree, not deleted code. More to the point, the file still shipped the ungated selector: GRID_SIZES = [25,36,49,64] with every segment clickable and gridSize forwarded to startMinesGame, i.e. exactly the divergence LIVE_RAIL_GRID_SIZES was created to close, sitting one route-map entry away from being reachable again. MinefieldPro.tsx now imports LIVE_RAIL_GRID_SIZES and applies the same gate and the same per-control reason string as MinesBetPanel, and its header comment now states the real reachability instead of claiming the file is dead. A stale "this is unmounted" note is how a resurrected divergence gets missed. ★ STILL OPEN, not a frame gap: the ADMIN key mines_house_edge (default 0.03) is read by NOTHING on the live rail, so the gaming-config panel is decorative for this game. ★ 2026-08-05 GRID-SIZE GATE VERIFIED IN A BROWSER, not just in source. /play/mines rendered at 1440 and the Grid Size row reports, from the live DOM: 25 enabled; 36 disabled with title '36-tile boards are not supported by the settlement engine yet'; 49 disabled with the matching message; and Custom disabled with 'No custom board sizes are available'. So the control now tells the truth instead of silently no-opping, and the 64-tile path that used to quote a 64-tile ladder against a 25-tile settlement is unreachable from either the segments or Custom. The legacy MinefieldPro dialog (still a live branch in Play.tsx's switch, though the tile routes) was brought to the same gate this pass so a remount cannot resurrect the divergence. ★★★ 2026-08-05 CLOSED. All four remaining partial frames resolve, so the family flips partial -> done. 9163-4859 (desktop page), 9163-5572 (mobile page) and 9003-111181 (tablet B, the shape actually implemented) were each held partial ONLY for standing product rules and deliberate one-implementation choices - the no-mock-data exclusion of Figma's sample rows, the app-wide no-practice-mode rule, the frames' own Dice-art and Dice-title leftovers, two Figma copy defects shipped corrected, and a responsive tablet board rather than a second pixel set. None is outstanding work. 9003-110110 (tablet A) is RE-FILED from partial to deferred: it is a rejected rival that contradicts both tablet B and the mobile frame, so building it would mean un-building B - the same treatment this catalog already gives 9003-118852, 9003-83784, 9003-98680 and 9003-132031. Re-verified in a real browser on /play/mines at 1440: 0 of 10 bet-panel labels missing, 0 of 7 page regions missing, 0 forbidden strings, 0px horizontal overflow, no error boundary. ★ THE PANEL PRINTS THE RAIL AND THE ARITHMETIC CLOSES: Potential Profit renders 1.0795x at the default 3 mines / 25 tiles, and 0.95 x 25/22 = 1.07954..., i.e. the correct first-pick odds at exactly the 5% house edge - the same 95% RTP dice and darts run - computed from live state rather than printed from the frame.
